title: Hash-inequality asserts in NonPositionalRecordsTests can collide
lead: tests/squalify.Tests/NonPositionalRecordsTests.cs asserts `NotEqual(baseline.GetHashCode(), changed.GetHashCode())` per member. HashCode is seeded per process, so each case has about a 2^-32 chance of a false failure. Replace the inequality of hash codes with the equality-implies-equal-hash direction only, or assert equality inequality, and mutation-check.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Check whether other tests use the same pattern; 2. change the assertions; 3. mutation-check.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: Build, test and format pass; `slicer check` passes.
